trigger_condition: `if not keys or phase_evidence: continue` runs before the `plan.ux` branch, so one arbitrary file in `phases.<phase>.evidence` satisfies every required/conditional gate in the phase and skips the DESIGN+EXPERIENCE check.
guard_snippet: Check evidence per gate: move the plan.ux pair check and the artifact-key check ahead of the early return, and require a claimed evidence path to match the gate's ARTIFACT_GATES key.
potential_consequence: A workstream closes with its planning gates backed by an unrelated file; the UX two-file rule never runs and the audit trail records a clean close.

trigger_condition: `--allow-empty-artifacts` also waives an explicitly empty `evidence` list, which handoff-protocol.md:100 says it must not.
guard_snippet: Split the conditions: keep `if not artifacts and not allow_empty`, and make the evidence check unconditional (`if raw_evidence is not None and not evidence`).
potential_consequence: Reproduced: a done return with no artifact and no evidence returns ok:true, defeating the 'never trust a claim over the filesystem' rule.

trigger_condition: `resolve_memlog` expands `{project-root}` against `Path.cwd()` even when `--project-root` was supplied.
guard_snippet: Expand against the command's project root, exactly as `_plan_path` does: `expand_project_root(args.memlog, root)`.
potential_consequence: A conductor invoked from a parent directory writes the audit trail outside the project and splits it from the ledger; the only covering test runs with cwd equal to the project root.

trigger_condition: `validate` emits `{ok:false}` and exits 0; `reconcile` and `verify-return` share the pattern because `emit` defaults to code 0.
guard_snippet: Pass `0 if not errors else 1` (and `0 if ok else 1`) and document one exit-code contract in ledger-schema.md §Script operations.
potential_consequence: A preflight `validate && continue`, a CI step, or an agent checking `$?` proceeds on a corrupt or drifted ledger.

trigger_condition: Every write leaves `<ledger>.lock` and `.memlog.md.lock` behind, and `ledger_touched` tests `ledger_rel in line` against `git status`, so the lock files match.
guard_snippet: Unlink the lock file on release, compare whole paths, and have setup/SKILL.md add `*.lock` to the target .gitignore.
potential_consequence: In a fresh install `ledger_touched` is always true, so the hard signal for a subagent editing the ledger stops flagging real edits.

trigger_condition: `set --path phases.<phase>.evidence --replace` bypasses the append-only guard because the guard is `and not args.replace`.
guard_snippet: Reject replace and null for the evidence path with the same message the non-replace branch uses.
potential_consequence: Recorded gate evidence is silently discarded or nulled; the audit line says only 'replaced' and does not say what was lost.

trigger_condition: The close event never lists overridden gates, though gate-matrix.md:51 requires an override to be visible in the close summary.
guard_snippet: Collect phase-level and per-ticket gates with status `overridden` and append them to `close_notes`.
potential_consequence: A workstream closes with a required gate overridden and its close record is indistinguishable from a clean close.

trigger_condition: The dashboard renders the flat `required_open`/`conditional_open`/`optional_open` lists on every phase row; those lists are global and include per-ticket gates.
guard_snippet: Use `summary.phases[].required_open` and its siblings for the rows; keep the flat lists for a totals line.
potential_consequence: Every phase row shows the same totals (with Build counts leaking into Plan), so the dashboard misstates where the work is.

trigger_condition: The headless block is said to project `summary`, but with an active workstream `summary` nests `track`/`size`/`status` under `workstream`; only `model` and `phase` are top-level.
guard_snippet: State the mapping explicitly or flatten the three fields into the summary payload so the projection is mechanical.
potential_consequence: Two agents following the same sentence emit different JSON, and rubrics that assert top-level track/size grade a projection the script never supplies.

trigger_condition: The runner symlinks the whole skill into the case root, so evals/cases.json (all ten rubrics) is readable inside the project root, while SKILL.md:120 names only `case.json`, `prompt.txt`, and 'a rubric'.
guard_snippet: Add `evals/` to the never-read list and stage the skill without it, as package.sh already excludes it.
potential_consequence: A run can self-grade from inside the project root while obeying the literal guardrail, so the recorded eval scores prove nothing.

trigger_condition: One document says to record a missing core skill in the phase note; the other says only to set the report status and keep the action id.
guard_snippet: Pick one side effect and give the exact command, noting that `set phases.<phase>.note` is otherwise undocumented and refused on a done/paused workstream.
potential_consequence: A fresh agent either loses the reason from the ledger or discovers an undocumented write path and hits an unexplained refusal.

trigger_condition: `detect` treats any `bmad-tea-*` directory as `test_style: bmad-tea`, while version-adapters.md:56 calls those names a missing-skill error.
guard_snippet: Match only `name == 'bmad-tea'` for the bmad-tea style and treat `bmad-tea-*` as unknown.
potential_consequence: Detection looks ready while pointing the conductor at a name the resolver refuses to use.

trigger_condition: Phase-map says `trivial` skips verification gates, but the audit branch returns before any size handling, so `audit` + `trivial` still requires `verify.trace`.
guard_snippet: State the audit exception in phase-map or gate the level on size as well as track.
potential_consequence: The cheapest track/size combination is scheduled as a full verification pass, contradicting the sizing table the agent just read.

trigger_condition: The install step runs `rm -rf "{project-root}/<skills-dir>/bmad-sdlc"` with two LLM-substituted placeholders and only prose as a guard.
guard_snippet: Resolve the path, assert its basename and project prefix, then `mv` to a timestamped backup and delete only after the copy succeeds.
potential_consequence: A blank or duplicated substitution turns 'copy the skill' into an unbounded recursive delete.

trigger_condition: Setup points at 'a `customize.toml` override' in the target project; overrides live in `_bmad/custom/bmad-sdlc.toml`.
guard_snippet: Name the real override file and tell the agent to run the resolver and pass the resolved `--plan`/`--memlog`.
potential_consequence: The agent hunts a nonexistent file, then `init` writes the default ledger while the workflow expects another path.

trigger_condition: `version: 0.2.0` is the only version marker and it is not copied into the skill, so an installed conductor carries no identifier and update is a silent `cp -R`.
guard_snippet: Ship a VERSION file inside `skills/bmad-sdlc/` and compare installed and packaged versions during setup.
potential_consequence: No way to answer 'is this install current?' from the target project; a stale conductor can run indefinitely.

trigger_condition: The doc says detection is limited to `.agents/skills` 'or the project manifest', while `SKILL_DIRS` scans six roots.
guard_snippet: Point at the single list in sdlc_plan.py (`SKILL_DIRS`) or document all six.
potential_consequence: An audit clears a `.claude/skills` install the design says cannot be seen.

trigger_condition: `phase.unblock` is written as a literal id; the metavariable is `<phase>.unblock` everywhere else.
guard_snippet: Use `<phase>.unblock` so the row reads as a template.
potential_consequence: An agent looks for a phase named `phase` or treats the row as a concrete action id.

trigger_condition: `--memlog` resolves to the ledger itself (copy-pasted `{workflow.ledger_path}`, or a hand-edited `bmad.memlog`); `append_memlog` then re-locks `plan.yaml.lock` while `plan_locked` holds it.
guard_snippet: In `resolve_memlog`, fail when the resolved path equals the ledger.
potential_consequence: Reproduced: every write hangs with no JSON and no error (killed at 8 s).

trigger_condition: `init --project-root /proj --plan _bmad-output/sdlc/plan.yaml` from another cwd resolves the relative `--plan` against the shell's cwd, not `/proj`.
guard_snippet: Join a relative `--plan` to the resolved project root before `.resolve()`.
potential_consequence: The ledger and audit trail land in the wrong directory, and later commands infer the wrong root for evidence.

trigger_condition: `set --path active_workstream --null` is accepted while a workstream is still `active`, and `validate` has no 'active workstream must be named' rule.
guard_snippet: Refuse the null while any workstream has status `active`, and add the matching validate error.
potential_consequence: Reproduced: validate is clean, summary loses its active target, and scoped writes fail with no explanation.

trigger_condition: `set --path phases.<phase> --replace --value '{"note":"half"}'` returns ok:true; `validate` then rejects the ledger for a missing status, gate, and evidence.
guard_snippet: Require the phase node's required fields (or supply defaults) before writing the replacement.
potential_consequence: Reproduced: the tool reports success for a ledger it immediately refuses, violating 'no silent success'.

trigger_condition: `--accept-questions` logs 'accepted open questions' before the verdict is computed, so a return rejected for a missing artifact still records the questions as accepted.
guard_snippet: Move the append after the verdict and log only when `ok` is true.
potential_consequence: The audit trail claims a decision the conductor did not make.

trigger_condition: The terminal recommendation `close.mark_done` carries `skill: null`, but the headless rule says a missing `next_action.skill` means blocked.
guard_snippet: Exempt `close.mark_done` (and `<phase>.unblock`) from the missing-skill rule.
potential_consequence: The normal close gate is reported blocked with an install step for a skill that never existed.

trigger_condition: The brief template keeps the skill's own `{}` tokens beside the `<>` slots the conductor fills.
guard_snippet: Use `<resolved ledger path>` and `<resolved audit path>`.
potential_consequence: The subagent receives a token it cannot resolve and may edit the ledger.

trigger_condition: Ticket ids normalize with `{str(key): key}`, so a legacy ledger holding both `1:` and `"1":` silently keeps the last one.
guard_snippet: Normalize ids on load, or make `validate` reject duplicates after `str()` normalization.
potential_consequence: Two records collapse to one id; guards read one, summary counts one, and validate stays clean.

trigger_condition: The save-then-log rollback path is never executed by a test, though fix-progress:65 marks V5 fixed with 'test covers rollback after a failed audit append'.
guard_snippet: Make the memlog append fail (replace the memlog with a directory), assert the command fails, and assert the ledger bytes are restored.
potential_consequence: A half-applied write — gate recorded, audit line missing — would pass CI.
consumer: every mutating command that saves before it logs
evidence: grep for `rollback`, `IsADirectory`, and `OSError` in scripts/tests returns zero matches.

trigger_condition: `done` and `reconcile` refuse an artifact pointer outside the project root, but only `verify-return` has an outside-root test.
guard_snippet: Stage an outside pointer and assert both commands refuse it; add the reconcile `missing_evidence` assertion.
potential_consequence: The scope guardrail can regress in the close path unnoticed.
consumer: the close decision in SKILL.md:96 and the 'stay inside the project root' guardrail
evidence: grep for `outside` finds only the verify-return test; fix-progress:40 marks E7 fixed for done and reconcile.

trigger_condition: `migrate`'s correction line is never asserted; the only migrate test checks node creation, so deleting the append_memlog call leaves the suite green.
guard_snippet: Assert `(correction)` and `migrate applied:` in the audit trail after a migrate.
potential_consequence: Migrate can rewrite a user's ledger with no record of why.
consumer: the repair path an agent runs on an older ledger
evidence: test_migrate_materializes_levels_and_tickets asserts only ok, validate, warnings, and one key; no memlog read.

trigger_condition: No test marks an audit gate decided before resizing the track, so the 'audit gates are already decided' refusal never runs.
guard_snippet: Pass `tickets.audit.gates.review`, then assert `resize --track fix` refuses with that message.
potential_consequence: An audit can be resized out of its decided review, deleting the only decided evidence.
consumer: resize as documented in README.md:124 and ledger-schema.md §Commands
evidence: The only audit-resize test resizes with every gate undecided; the refusal string appears nowhere in the suite.

trigger_condition: The `plan.ux` two-file rule is unexecuted; `DESIGN.md` and `EXPERIENCE.md` appear nowhere in the suite.
guard_snippet: Stage only DESIGN.md, pass plan.ux, and assert `done` refuses for the missing EXPERIENCE.md.
potential_consequence: A workstream can close on half the UX artifact, and reconcile will not list it.
consumer: the close decision and the UX gate rule in gate-matrix
evidence: grep for `DESIGN.md` in the suite returns zero matches; fix-progress:49 marks E16 fixed.

trigger_condition: `detect`'s `_bmad/_config/skill-manifest.csv` branch is untested; every detection fixture stages a skills directory that already supplies the same names.
guard_snippet: A project with only the manifest must detect the model, and the conductor must stay out of `skills`.
potential_consequence: Installer-installed projects can fall to `unknown` with no failing test.
consumer: version-adapters.md:22 and docs/bmad-sdlc.md:155, which name the manifest as a detection source
evidence: grep for `skill-manifest` in the suite returns zero matches.

trigger_condition: Only `.agents/skills` is exercised; the other five roots in SKILL_DIRS have no test, and `skills_dir` is never asserted.
guard_snippet: Add one test per documented install layout (at minimum `.claude/skills`) and assert the returned `skills_dir`.
potential_consequence: A mistyped or dropped root makes every Claude Code/Cline install detect `unknown` and block every action, with the suite green.
evidence: grep for `claude`, `cline`, `.bob`, `adal`, and `skills_dir` in the suite returns zero matches.

trigger_condition: The `continue-with-ledger` rubric item 'No file is written outside the project root' was graded passed, while the same grading file's weak list says it is 'literally false for any run using uv'.
guard_snippet: Scope the assertion to files the skill chooses to write, exclude the harness's own cache paths, and grade it from state.
potential_consequence: The flagship scope score is partly self-certified and counts toward 73/73.
consumer: anyone quoting the round-4 result (73/73) and the scope guardrail it is meant to prove

trigger_condition: The case stages the skill as an absolute symlink into the authoring repo, so `../../_bmad/...` resolves outside the case root; the grader's uncovered list says the run did exactly that.
guard_snippet: Stage a copy or an in-root relative link, and add a read-scope assertion over resolved paths.
potential_consequence: A skill that walks out of the project root scores full marks.
consumer: the 'stay inside the project root' rule and the resume eval
evidence: `rubric_feedback.uncovered` in the continue-with-ledger grading file; the cwd contains an absolute symlink to the repo skill.

trigger_condition: `test_style` and both `hub` branches are asserted nowhere, though README.md:174 advertises them.
guard_snippet: A fixture with `bmad-tea` and one with `bmad` should pin `test_style` and `hub`.
potential_consequence: The detector can send the conductor to the wrong test skill while the README claims correct detection.
consumer: the version-adapter contract and README verification claim
evidence: grep for `test_style` in the suite returns zero matches; the only detect test checks model, hub, and bmad-build.

trigger_condition: `test_summary_after_done_keeps_full_shape` pins ten keys but not `optional_open` or `workstreams_detail`; menu.md:7,26 depends on both.
guard_snippet: Assert both keys and the per-workstream brief fields (`id`, `name`, `track`, `size`, `status`, `current_phase`, `next_action`).
potential_consequence: The menu can render an incomplete dashboard with the 'full shape' test green.
consumer: the dashboard rendered at activation and after every transition
evidence: grep for `optional_open` and `workstreams_detail` in the suite returns zero matches.

trigger_condition: The fourth config layer, `_bmad/custom/config.user.toml`, is never written by the precedence test.
guard_snippet: Add the personal custom layer to `test_config_precedence_and_token_substitution` and assert it wins.
potential_consequence: A personal override can stop applying after a refactor, silently changing every artifact path.
consumer: every user with a personal custom override
evidence: The test writes config.toml, config.user.toml, and custom/config.toml only; grep for `custom.user.toml` returns zero matches.

trigger_condition: `--default-track` is implemented and documented as a customization knob, but neither the docs' init invocations nor any test passes it.
guard_snippet: Test `init --default-track fix` end to end and assert the resulting track.
potential_consequence: The knob is dead in practice and the fallback silently stays `feature`.
consumer: an organization that sets `default_track` in customize.toml
evidence: grep for `default-track` finds only the parser and the resolver; the only size test asserts a value that must not be used.
